summary: The link of w_p σ is the graph of the middle block of σ, independent of p.

steps.claim: Restate: the links are equal iff they have the same members (pairs indexed by a disjoint union), and σ = τ iff w_p σ = w_p τ as matrices.
steps.lean: rw [SetLike.ext_iff, forall_sum, forall_comm, ← mul_right_inj (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p), Subtype.ext_iff]

steps.claim: By mem_link and the matrix of w_p σ (coe_weylElem_mul): for (p₁, p₂) to lie in link(w_p σ), the e*-part of w_p σ(a, p₂, 0) = (0, σ_mid p₂, (p_b a_b)_b) must vanish, forcing a = 0, and then p₁ = σ_mid p₂. So link(w_p σ) is the graph of the middle block of σ (whatever p), and the links agree iff the middle blocks of σ and τ agree, i.e. iff σ = τ (both are the identity on the e_a and e*_a).
steps.lean:
simp [*, ↓Units.ext_iff, mem_link, ↓coe_weylElem_mul, elim_eq_iff, ← elim_add_add,
    ← ext_iff_mulVec, (⟨_, mulVec_zero _⟩ : ∃ x, _ = _)]
